indicator_name: WGI: Political Stability and Absence of Violence/Terrorism, governance estimate (approx. -2.5 to +2.5), all economies
description: WGI: Политическая стабильность и отсутствие насилия (оценка, от -2,5 до +2,5), страны мира
unit: governance estimate, standard normal units (approx. -2.5 to +2.5)
methodology: Worldwide Governance Indicators (Kaufmann-Kraay), Political Stability and Absence of Violence/Terrorism. Item = ISO3. Biennial 1996-2002 (1996, 1998, 2000), annual from 2002. Estimates are standardised each year across countries, so a level change partly reflects the other countries.
